title: Yeasty Crunchy Saudi-Arabian All-Purpose Seasoning Flatbread
description: A flavorful and crunchy flatbread infused with the warm spices of Saudi-Arabia, perfect for a date-night dinner. Made with a yeast-based dough and topped with a blend of all-purpose seasoning.
instructions: Combine yeast, sugar, and warm water in a large bowl. Let the mixture sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
Add flour, salt, and olive oil to the bowl. Mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4-6 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and flatten it slightly.
Place the flatbreads in the pressure cooker and cook for 5 minutes.
Let the flatbreads cool for 5 minutes before serving.
